answer: Use a sequential-work admission ticket. First, the network gives each applicant an unpredictable seed. Second, the applicant runs a 24-hour verifiable delay function bound to its public key. Third, validators check the proof and admit that key for one epoch. Audits act as a prism, separating fresh tickets from replays. At an assumed $0.40 per core-hour, 1,000 identities require $9,600 and 1,000 occupied cores for 24 hours. Like a trellis climbing a mesa, each identity needs its own support all the way up; copying the leaves cannot supply the missing stems.
